Kunal Sharma
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Cochin
kunal.sharma820@example.com | +91 9252911310

Experienced HR and cloud operations professional with a strong track record in end-to-end recruitment, onboarding, payroll administration, and cloud engineering. Combines technical experience with people-focused HR practices to streamline hiring processes, improve new-hire retention, and automate routine workflows. Notices: 30 days.

- Led onboarding improvements that cut new-hire time-to-productivity by 18% by standardizing orientation checklists and coordinating cross-functional Onboarding activities.
- Automated payroll data handoffs and verification steps with scripted exports, reducing payroll processing errors by 35% while maintaining Payroll compliance and audit readiness.

HR Executive

- Owned Onboarding and Payroll coordination for new hires, introducing batch onboarding sessions and payroll reconciliation checks that decreased onboarding follow-up tasks by 30%.

Cloud Engineer
